hidden.name: Leaders (RS ≥ 90)
hidden.description: RS 90+ stocks, MAs stacked, within 15% of the 52 week high, 4%+ daily range, $20M+ traded, price $5+

hidden.name: RS new highs on a red day
hidden.description: Stocks whose RS line made a 52-week high on a session SPY closed down 0.5% or more, $10M+ traded, price $5+

hidden.name: Up on down days (3+ of 20)
hidden.description: Stocks that closed up on at least 3 of the last 20 sessions' SPY down days (SPY down 0.5% or more), $10M+ traded, price $5+

hidden.name: RS line crossed above its 21 EMA within 5 bars
hidden.description: Stocks whose RS line against SPY crossed above its 21-day EMA within the last 5 sessions and is still above it, $10M+ traded, price $5+

hidden.name: Mansfield turned positive this month
hidden.description: Stocks whose Mansfield RS (the RS line against its own 200-day average) crossed zero within the last 21 sessions and reads above zero now, $10M+ traded, price $5+

hidden.name: Leaders vs equal-weight too
hidden.description: RS 80+ stocks whose RS line is above its 21-day EMA and whose 20-day RS slope has the same sign against SPY and against equal-weight RSP, $10M+ traded, price $5+

hidden.name: Quicksand in the last 5 sessions
hidden.description: Stocks whose RS line against SPY, after breaking below its 21-day average, closed below the level of that break in the last 5 sessions (Mike Webster's Quicksand), $10M+ traded, price $5+. A warning to review the position, not an order to sell

method.label: Relative Strength screens

screens.name: Top RS Rating
screens.rule: Every stock on the liquidity floor that holds an RS Rating place, strongest first. The order is the unrounded score behind the rating, so stocks that share a rating are told apart and no two share a place. The overall list needs a full year of price history. The 1, 3, 6 and 12-month lists need only a value for that window, so a newer listing appears on the shorter lists. Stocks flagged Buyout pending are left out.
screens.controls: Rank by chooses the list: overall, one window, or Rising fastest (the largest gain in RS Rating over 20 stored sessions, among stocks above their 50-day line). Show narrows it to RS Rating 90 and up, or to stocks at 90 or higher now that were under 90 20 stored sessions ago.
screens.caveat: A rating is a rank of past return, not a forecast. Rising fastest is partly stocks bouncing back, so read it as a list to study.

screens.name: RS New Highs
screens.rule: The RS line (the stock's price divided by SPY's, daily closes) closed above its highest close of the prior 252 sessions within the last 5 sessions, and the stock closed above its 200-day average. Newest first; stocks whose RS high came on the same session are ordered by RS Rating score. Stocks flagged Buyout pending are left out.
screens.controls: When: today, the last 5 sessions, or the last 21. Min RS Rating. Market: Down days only keeps a stock whose RS line made that high within the last 10 sessions on a day SPY closed down 0.5% or more.
screens.caveat: An RS line can rise while the stock falls, when SPY falls faster. The market down day reading is a house method with no published test.

screens.name: RS New High Before Price
screens.rule: The RS line made a 52-week high within the last 5 sessions and price has not made its own 52-week closing high since, the stock closed 3% to 25% below that high, and above its 200-day average. Closest to its high first. A stock leaves the list once price makes its high. Stocks flagged Buyout pending are left out.
screens.controls: When: today, the last 5 sessions, or the last 21. Below its high by: at least 3%, 5% or 10%. Min RS Rating.
screens.caveat: The RS line leading price is a trader's rule with no published test. An empty list is normal in a weak market.

screens.name: UCT RS Leaders
screens.rule: Stocks on the liquidity floor with an average daily range of 3% or more, a market value of $300M or more, RS Rating 80 or higher, the RS line above its 21-day average, a close above a rising 200-day average, and price within 25% of its 52-week high. The 50 with the highest RS Rating score are shown, strongest first. Stocks flagged Buyout pending are left out.
screens.controls: Show: all, only stocks near a buy point, or everything except Extended and Below its 50-day line. Min RS Rating: 80, 85, 90, 95.
screens.caveat: RS Rating 80 is a convention, not a tested threshold. The list says which stocks to study, and the Setup label says where each one sits against its own averages.

screens.name: RS exit warnings
screens.rule: The RS line against SPY flashed a Quick Break, a Quicksand or a Grateful Dead Break (Mike Webster's warnings, our reading of them) within the last 5 sessions. Newest first.
screens.controls: Type keeps one kind of warning.
screens.caveat: A warning is a prompt to review a position, not an order to sell.

setup.order: The first rule that matches names the stock. Tight range is a second tag that can sit beside any of them.
setup.atr: ATR is the 14-session average true range, the stock's typical daily move in dollars.

labels.label: Below its 50-day line
labels.rule: The close is under the 50-day simple average.

labels.label: Extended
labels.rule: 4 or more ATRs above the 50-day average, or 3 or more ATRs above the 21-day EMA, or more than 5% past a base pivot.
labels.source: The 4 ATR limit is Jeff Sun's published rule. 3 ATRs over the 21-day is a house threshold with no published test. 5% past a pivot is the top of IBD's published range.

labels.label: At pivot
labels.rule: From 3% below a base pivot to 5% above it. The pivot is the one the Base Structure column names for the stock on this build.
labels.source: 5% above the pivot is IBD's published range. 3% below is a house threshold.

labels.label: Pullback to the 8-day
labels.rule: The stock made a 20-session high within the last 15 sessions and is now trading at its rising 8-day average. In numbers: the high is a closing high, and today its low came within 0.5 ATR of a rising 8-day EMA while its close is no more than 0.5 ATR under it. An EMA is rising when it stands above its value 5 sessions earlier. Named ahead of the 21-day when both hold. It marks where the stock is, not what to do.
labels.source: The 8-day and 21-day EMAs are the house teaching averages. The half-ATR band is a house threshold with no published test.

labels.label: Pullback to the 21-day
labels.rule: The stock made a 20-session high within the last 15 sessions and is now trading at its rising 21-day average. In numbers: the high is a closing high, and today its low came within 0.5 ATR of a rising 21-day EMA while its close is no more than 0.5 ATR under it. An EMA is rising when it stands above its value 5 sessions earlier. It marks where the stock is, not what to do.
labels.source: The same house rule, on the 21-day EMA.

labels.label: Uptrend, no setup
labels.rule: None of the above, with the close at or above the 50-day average.

tight.label: Tight range
tight.rule: The Tight Consolidation column reads yes for the stock.

flags.label: Buyout pending
flags.rule: One session closed 15% or more above the prior close within the last 60 sessions, at least 5 sessions ago, and every close since has stayed inside a 1.5% range.

flags.label: One-day move
flags.rule: Over the last 63 sessions the stock is up, and one session's gain was more than half of that rise and at least 15% on its own.

flags.label: New issue
flags.rule: Fewer than 253 daily bars of price history.

setup.near: Near a buy point means At pivot, a Pullback, or a Tight range. It never includes a stock that is Extended, Below its 50-day line, Buyout pending or a One-day move. It describes where price sits against its own averages. It is not a recommendation.
setup.blank: A label is blank when one of the measures it needs cannot be computed, and for a stock whose price history contradicts itself. A blank is never replaced by the next label down.

method.floor: Every screen here is stocks only, no funds, with a price of $10 or more and $20M or more traded a day on a 30-day average. The benchmark is SPY, on daily closing prices.
method.ratings_as_of: Ratings as of names the market session the RS Rating numbers on a row describe. The rating job scores each completed session at 04:15 ET the next morning. Between the 03:00 ET screener build and that job the screens keep the previous session's ratings and places, and this date says so.
method.rating_note: Our RS Rating is our own calculation. It follows IBD's published method and can differ from IBD's number by a few points.
method.honesty: Every screen and label here describes the past. Each one says which stocks to study, not what will happen next, and none of them is a forecast or a recommendation.

filters.label: SMA50 Distance
filters.description: Percent the price is above (+) or below (-) its 50-day simple moving average. During the session this follows the live price, while a field measured at the last completed session does not, so comparing the two mixes two clocks.

filters.label: SMA200 Distance
filters.description: Percent the price is above (+) or below (-) its 200-day simple moving average. During the session this follows the live price, while a field measured at the last completed session does not, so comparing the two mixes two clocks.

filters.label: RS high on a down day, age
SMA200 Rising
filters.description: Yes when the average stands above its own value 20 sessions earlier. Blank until both values exist. Measured at the last completed session.
